cover.overview: Add one small table and one picture with alt text that would still help if the picture were gone.

blocks.heading: A picture that still works if it vanishes
blocks.body: **Alt text** is the sentence that stands in for the picture. “image1” is not a sentence. “Clear glass vase with three stems” is.

lessons.title: Table plus a picture with alt

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Table plus a picture with alt.

This lab can fail. Fail when: Alt text is empty or “image1”, or the hours table is gone, or a red error remains.

Expected: Hours table intact. Picture has real alt text. Files clean.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Table plus a picture with alt.
blocks.intro: How to Table plus a picture with alt. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Table plus a picture with alt
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: On studio-hours.dita, confirm the Day / Hours table still scans in one glance.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: On the explaining page, insert a picture if the pack has one (samples/flower-docs images). If not, insert a placeholder image from the sample and keep going.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Write alt text that names what is in the picture, not “image1”. Example: “Clear glass vase with three stems.”

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Do not put a huge table on the how-to. Hours stay on the lookup page.

blocks.summary: Hours table intact. Picture has real alt text. Files clean.

blocks.body: The lab is done. Prove it with the check. Use words from today only.
